ap_physics_1-m21.set_intro: A cart moves along a straight horizontal track. The graph shows the velocity of the cart as a function of time, with right taken as positive.

stimulus.description: Velocity versus time of a cart

items.stem: What is the displacement of the cart from $t=0$ to $t=11\text{ s}$? Positive is to the right.

options.why: Displacement is the signed area under the velocity-time graph, and average acceleration is the change in velocity divided by the elapsed time of the segment. With the values given in the question, this gives $51.0\text{ m}$.
Uses only the first segment.

Averages the first and last velocities and multiplies by the time.
